reviews.text: Replies: 0 Rating: 5 stars I’ve been using the Avarole AI Assistant plugin on my website for a while now, and honestly, it’s been a great addition. The avatars are probably my favourite part. They look very realistic and make conversations feel much more natural and personal compared to a regular chatbot. I also really like how easy it is for visitors to find what they’re looking for. The site navigation feature takes them directly to the right pages or products without having to search through the entire website. The built-in ticketing system is another big plus. It keeps all customer queries organised in one place and makes managing support much easier. Getting everything set up was straightforward, and I haven’t noticed any impact on my website’s performance. Considering the features, AI quality, and overall experience, I think it’s well worth the price. Overall, it’s been a really useful tool for improving customer engagement and making website support easier. Definitely worth checking out.
reviews.title: [Avarole AI Assistant] Lifelike avatars, useful features, and a fair price (5 stars)
